description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer interface. It contains the structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript logic to display databases, tables, and table data, allowing user interaction such as refresh and expand cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the database list in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of available databases by re-fetching from the backend API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database in the sidebar and loads its tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database from the backend API and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table, showing a table with data in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the HTML table from the data fetched for a specific database table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates the HTML for a table cell based on its value, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated version when clicked.
